p local-id

Tao asked whether KAG had compared traditional

knowledge graph triples with JSON-like structured representations or embed

ding-based representations, particularly in terms of performance and accura

cy.

p local-id

4ced8f59b0a3

Liu Huifang suggested that the structured repr

esentation approach might improve performance because knowledge is organize

d into a model-friendly format during the initial processing stage.

p local-id

Vincent asked whether this LLM-friendly format

was fixed. Liu Huifang explained that it could be customized by users. She

also noted that knowledge types could be divided into three layers to supp

ort more domain-specific and personalized representations.

p local-id

c64cd5fba18a

Mu Guangyuan asked about the purpose of confid

ence scores and the three knowledge layers. Liu Huifang explained that they

could support knowledge extraction accuracy and help large language models

understand composite entities and relationships.

gner to avoid introducing additional uncertainty.

of confidence scores depend on the specific standards, scenarios, and inte

nded applications.
